summary: While the consolidation of episode state into episode.json and the refinement of Herdr identity verification in goal-self-send.ts address key multi-file state metastasization and self-send reliability issues, critical edge cases remain. Specifically, the plugin-wide approved-artifact-persist hook evaluates project governance against process.cwd() prior to reading the stdin payload, causing silent persistence skips when executed from project subdirectories. Additionally, episode state objects initialized with a null sessionId are never backfilled when a session ID becomes available, breaking downstream session-matching checks in clarify-before-recon-guard.

findings.title: Plugin-wide plan persistence evaluates process.cwd() before parsing payload, failing in subdirectories
findings.body: In hooks/approved-artifact-persist.ts, isGoverned(process.cwd()) and readEpisodeState(process.cwd()) are evaluated before reading and parsing stdin payload. If a tool or command executes while the working directory is a subdirectory of the project, process.cwd() will not contain .claude-workflows.json. As a result, isGoverned() returns false and the hook silently exits with code 0 without persisting the approved plan receipt or governing the episode.
findings.recommendation: Read and parse Bun.stdin payload before performing governance and episode state checks, and resolve the project root directory from payload.cwd or payload.project_dir instead of relying solely on process.cwd().

findings.title: Episode state sessionId is never backfilled once initialized as null
findings.body: In hooks/writing-suggest-verify.ts (episodeFor) and scripts/beat/implement-gate.ts (recordImplementPhase), existing episode state objects are reused without updating sessionId if existing.sessionId was previously null. If episode.json is initialized early without a session ID, existing.sessionId remains null permanently. Consequently, clarify-before-recon-guard.ts fails the value.sessionId === payload.session_id check and falls back to sentinel files.
findings.recommendation: Update existing.sessionId to the current non-null sessionId when updating episode state in episodeFor() and recordImplementPhase().
